name: firstrun-welcome
alt: Devpit first-run wizard, step 1 of 4, Welcome, listing three promises: nothing is deleted without a preview and confirmation, the default answer is No, and nothing leaves the PC unless usage stats are on

name: home-menu
alt: Devpit main menu with the block-letter DEVPIT logo and six sections: Accounts, Free Up Disk Space, Ports & Network, Install & Update, Share Files and Devpit Settings

name: accounts-page
alt: Devpit Accounts page for a project folder: each tool with the account it uses there and why, such as a folder rule on C:\Projects, everywhere, or set by the project's .env.local for Convex

name: accounts-tool-claude
alt: Claude Code tool page in Devpit Accounts showing who is signed in, where that comes from, and actions such as Use another account here, Just this once, Sign in again and Bring your Claude Code setup over

name: accounts-picker
alt: Account picker asking which Claude Code account to use, with default and work listed, a type-to-filter box and Sign in with another account at the end

name: accounts-scope
alt: Where should work be used question with four choices: This folder, Everywhere, Just this once and Another folder

name: accounts-preview
alt: Plain-words preview of a Claude Code folder rule, listing the line Devpit will write to accounts.toml, with a Make this change question that starts on No

name: accounts-done
alt: Done card after an account change with a tick for each step and keys to verify, undo or go back to Accounts

name: accounts-verify
alt: Verify screen comparing the expected account with what each tool says is signed in, with a note that idle Claude Code accounts are only checked when asked

name: accounts-browse
alt: Browse folders tree showing Everywhere and the C:\Projects folder with the account each tool uses there

name: accounts-git
alt: Git page in Devpit Accounts with two rows, Commits as and Pushes as, and actions to commit as another identity, push as another GitHub account or push with an SSH key

name: accounts-git-preview
alt: Preview of a Git identity folder rule saying Git will commit as the work email in this folder and every folder inside it

name: accounts-ssh-key
alt: Push with an SSH key screen after making a new key: the key path, the public key in a box, and keys to copy it or use it for this folder

name: accounts-just-once
alt: Just this once screen showing the devpit claude run command to run one command with the work account, with nothing saved

name: accounts-claude-ask
alt: Bring your Claude Code setup question with the answers Keep them in sync, Copy them once, Start empty, Choose and Not now

name: accounts-claude-items
alt: Claude Code item list with a row per item, such as skills, agents, commands, CLAUDE.md, plugins, settings, hooks, MCP servers and chat history, each with a Safe, Review, Careful or Locked label and Share, Copy or Skip

name: accounts-claude-conflict
alt: Question about items the other Claude Code account already has, with the choices Keep, Replace and Keep both, and a note that nothing is deleted or overwritten

name: accounts-import
alt: Found accounts already on this PC card listing one Claude Code account and six folder links from claude-acc, with Use them in Devpit and Ignore

name: clean-menu
alt: Free Up Disk Space submenu with four rows: Project Junk, Full Scan, Choose folder and Resume interrupted deletes

name: clean-scanning
alt: Devpit scanning a projects folder, with a progress bar, the count of folders checked and items found so far, and the first results filling the list
note: Demo projects folder; capture mid-scan with some rows already listed.

name: clean-results
alt: Scan results grouped by project, each row with a tick box, a size bar and a risk label of Safe, Review or Careful, and a footer showing the selected total
note: Demo projects with node_modules, dist, .next and target folders; Safe items ticked, at least one Review and one Careful row visible.

name: clean-confirm
alt: Delete confirmation asking to delete 14 items of 2.1 GB, with restore hints such as run npm install, and the No button selected by default

name: clean-summary
alt: Summary card after a clean-up saying Freed 2.1 GB, with the number of items removed and how long it took

name: portsnet-menu
alt: Ports & Network menu with two entries: Fix stuck ports & apps, and Network tools, each with a one-line description

name: ports-menu
alt: Fix Stuck Ports and Apps submenu with three tools: Kill a port, Busy dev ports and Node processes

name: ports-kill-port
alt: Kill a port screen with port 3000 typed in and a table showing the listening node.exe process with its PID and address
note: Show the kill-process-tree option for an npm parent.

name: ports-busy
alt: Busy dev ports list showing ports 3000, 5173 and 8080 in use with process names and PIDs, some rows marked for killing

name: apps-menu
alt: Install & Update menu with two entries: Install developer apps, and Update everything, each with a one-line description

name: install-list
alt: Install Developer Apps list grouped by category, with some apps ticked, some marked installed and a short description under the highlighted app

name: install-running
alt: Devpit installing three apps one after another, each as a live row with a spinner or progress bar and the last line the installer printed

name: update-list
alt: Update Everything list of out-of-date apps grouped by winget, Scoop and Chocolatey, all ticked, with the installed and new version next to each

name: update-running
alt: Devpit updating apps one by one with live rows that end in a tick, a warning saying restart needed or a cross with a reason

name: update-admin-retry
alt: Update Everything near the end of a run: every app is done except Docker Desktop, whose row says retrying as administrator after it failed with error 0x80073D28

name: update-summary-problems
alt: Update Everything summary with nine apps updated, Docker Desktop skipped because it needs admin rights, Visual Studio Code in use and Git crashed with code 0xC0000409, and a What to do next list with the exact command for each

name: network-menu
alt: Network Tools submenu with three tools: My IP addresses, Ping a host and Flush DNS cache

name: network-ip
alt: My IP addresses card listing local interfaces with their IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and the public IP address below
note: Use documentation-range addresses (192.0.2.x, 2001:db8::) so no real address is shown.

name: network-ping
alt: Ping results for a host with four reply lines and a summary of packets sent and received and minimum, average and maximum time

name: settings-list
alt: Devpit Settings in six groups, Look, Cleaning, Tools, AI agents, Privacy and updates, and About, each row a label with its current value in a column of its own, and a pane on the right explaining the highlighted setting in plain words

name: settings-agent-skill
alt: AI agent skill screen in Settings: what the skill lets Claude Code do, what it never does, where SKILL.md is written, and an Install button

name: whats-new
alt: What's new card shown once after updating to Devpit 0.4: Accounts is new, where Git & SSH, the ports and network tools and Install and Update moved, an offer to open the AI agent skill screen, and the link to the full notes

name: share-card
alt: Share a folder card showing the IP address, share name, user name and temporary password, and ready-to-copy commands for a PC that does not have Devpit
note: Phase 2 screen. Use a documentation-range IP and a fake password.

name: share-progress
alt: Copy from a shared folder in progress: 47 of 80 GB done, current speed and time left, the files being copied right now and a retrying notice
